bullets.text: Millicom Eyes Telefónica Chile - **Millicom** considers a bid for **Telefónica Chile** as the latter exits non-core markets.
Ofcom's 6 GHz Spectrum Plan - **Ofcom** proposes a split-priority approach for the upper 6 GHz band for Wi-Fi and mobile.
Vodafone's Ads Banned - **ASA** bans **Vodafone**'s 'Nation's Network' ads for misleading claims about network superiority.
UK Cybersecurity Boost - The UK government allocates £210m to enhance public sector cyber defences amid rising threats.
5G Trials in Ukraine - **Kyivstar** launches a 5G pilot in **Lviv**, showcasing resilience amid ongoing conflict.
EchoStar's Spectrum Sell-off - **EchoStar** sells $40bn in spectrum to **AT&T** and **SpaceX**, reshaping U.S. wireless policy.
AI-RAN Delivers ROI - **AI-RAN** technology promises operational efficiency and energy savings for telecom operators.
Starlink's Free Internet - **Starlink** offers free internet in Venezuela amid political turmoil and regime challenges.
6G Networks to Automate Workflows - Future **6G** networks will host AI agents to streamline enterprise operations.
